<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

`pij directory` lists every live seat in the project that holds no role, each with the command that assigns it one or closes it.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Nothing runs unregistered.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Assigning anything automatically.
